description: This file defines a Tiptap extension 'BlockId' that manages block-level IDs in a rich text editor, including global attribute setup and a ProseMirror plugin for automatic ID assignment.

classes.name: BlockId
classes.description: A Tiptap extension that adds and manages block IDs for various block types, including automatic ID generation and HTML attribute parsing.

methods.name: addGlobalAttributes
methods.description: Defines global attributes for block types, adding a 'blockId' attribute with HTML parsing and rendering logic.

methods.name: addProseMirrorPlugins
methods.description: Adds a ProseMirror plugin that assigns unique IDs to blocks on document changes, handling nested blocks as well.
